definitions.explanation: The narrow part of the body between the ribs and the hips, and its measurement, as used for clothing sizes and figure. Also the waist part of a garment, such as the waistband of trousers or a skirt.

examples.japanese: ウエスト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ウエスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the waist of my trousers let out a little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧や⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ウエスト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{測|はか}られる→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: At the health checkup, they measure your waist as well as your height and weight.

notes:
From English "waist." Mainly a word about figure and clothing sizes; for the body region in general, ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧ is the everyday word (though ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧ centers lower, around the hips and lower back).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウエスト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧: to have a slim waist
- ウエスト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧ / ゆるい: tight / loose at the waist
- ウエスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure one's waist
- ウエスト⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧: emphasizing the waist with a belt or cinching (fashion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧: hips, lower back, waist area — the native word for the body part
